confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors draw on several mid-2026 third-party guides and Expatistan, Citizen Daily Post and Freenance figures that disagree and carry mixed dates, so treat them as approximate. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the beer relationship and the cited bar ranges, not from direct menu checks. The midrange meal assumes about 100 PLN per person for three courses without drinks. Zloty-to-USD conversion uses an approximate rate from model knowledge, not a live quote. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season and were not checked against live listings or booking pages. The FX observation was taken from an RBA overview page snippet in search results and was not opened directly; a third-party page reported a 16 October figure that I could not verify against the RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Krakow is a mid-sized Central European tourism city in Poland. Restaurant and drink price points are anchored to Polish local-price ranges. Accommodation is benchmarked loosely against other mid-sized Central European tourist cities in peak summer, without using live booking data.
